measurement.host: One isolated GitHub-hosted job, no concurrent benchmark process from this workflow.
measurement.launch: Fresh Chromium process and fresh real dedicated module worker per observation, launched serially; COOP same-origin/COEP require-corp, require crossOriginIsolated and SharedArrayBuffer/sharedWASM.
measurement.compilation: Module fetch, WASM compile/instantiation, ZIP reads and compressed-input transfer are outside all timers.
measurement.retention: Keep only resident compressed corpus and one decoded/source/result group. No whole decoded corpus or complete output retention.
measurement.warmupUnit: Two excluded complete 53-bank, 12-group passes in each measured observation worker, with the same validation and natural reference release policy as the measured pass. Untimed admission workers instead use the separately specified one-pass probe.
measurement.primaryTimer: Sum worker performance.now intervals around inflateCompressedTermBankSourcesWasm for all12groups, including complete source CRC validation and native stream completion.
measurement.secondaryTimer: Parse and completed lookup construction timed separately after logical source hashing; report separately and as sum of measured components, never as a contiguous import time.
measurement.outsideTimers: Source digest/spans, complete framed output projection hashing, fixture I/O, startup/compilation and result serialization. Verification is the same per-group policy for every arm; it may influence subsequent GC, which is not forcibly removed.
measurement.instrumentation: Timed workers do not wrap DecompressionStream/WASM functions or attach inspector/tracing; activation counters belong to separate untimed preflight workers.
measurement.options: Production JMdict semantic options/version3: validateGlossaryTypes=true; emitContentSlab, computeContentHashes, token binary content, prepared lookup and route=true; media flags=false; singleChunk=true, maxPendingChunks=1, compactContentMetadata=true. Secondary component covers parse, lookup and route construction; it excludes worker result copying, ownership transfer, compression and storage.
measurement.gcPolicy: No forced GC, inspector or memory sampler in any timed observation. Identical per-group digest/parity work remains outside timers; release references naturally. Native allocation, reclamation and retention costs remain in the fresh-browser worker lifecycle. No separate post-pass GC probe in this fixed budget.
